actions.name: generate_xml_from_sample
actions.title: Generate XML document from a sample XML
actions.description: Generates an XML document from a sample XML
actions.help: Use this action when you don't have an XSD, or when your XSD contains anyType /wildcard elements that can't be mapped directly. Provide a representative sample XML, and Workato will infer the element structure. Best suited for simpler or loosely-typed XML payloads where a full schema isn't available…

input.name: sample_xml
input.label: Sample XML document
input.hint: Paste a representative XML document. Its structure will be used to generate the input fields for this action.

input.name: payload_asset_type
input.label: XSD Document
input.hint: Optionally validate the generated XML against an XSD. • Define manually — Add any referenced XSDs under XSD references below. • Use a resource — References are resolved based on the file's folder path…

input.name: xsd_document
input.label: XSD document
input.hint: Optionally enter an XSD document to validate the generated XML against.

input.name: xsd_refs
input.label: XSD references

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.hint: Enter the XSD name as defined in the schemaLocation attribute of the XSD import/include tag. Use a simple file name without paths, for example: "imported.xsd".

properties.name: value
properties.label: Value
properties.hint: Enter the XSD document to be imported/included.

input.hint: If the XSD document includes any import or include references, list the names and corresponding values of the imported XSDs below.

input.name: xsd_document_static_asset
input.label: XSD Resource
input.hint: Select an XSD resource to be used for validating the generated XML.

actions.name: generate_xml_xsd
actions.title: Generate XML document from XSD
actions.description: Generates an XML document from the XSD provided
actions.help: This action creates an XML document structured according to the XSD schema and its referenced definitions supplied by the user. The content of the XML is derived from user input. The combined size of the XSD files must not exceed 10MB. Supports XSDs with up to 5000 elements. XSDs that exceed these l…

input.name: xsd_document
input.label: XSD document
input.hint: Enter the XSD document on which XML should be generated.

input.name: xsd_refs
input.label: XSD references

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.hint: Enter the XSD name as defined in the schemaLocation attribute of the XSD import/include tag. Use a simple file name without paths, for example: "imported.xsd".

properties.name: value
properties.label: Value
properties.hint: Enter the XSD document to be imported/included.

input.hint: If the XSD document includes any import or include references, list the names and corresponding values of the imported XSDs below.

actions.name: parse_xml

actions.help: Parse XML content to be used in subsequent recipe steps. First, provide a sample XML to generate the output datatree, then map the source of XML content. NOTE: This action is deprecated . Please use the new action.

input.name: type
input.label: XML type
input.hint: Select the type of XML to parse according to the level of detail needed.

input.name: sample_document
input.label: Sample document
input.hint: Used to generate the Workato output datatree for use in subsequent recipe steps

input.name: encoding
input.label: Encoding of the file content

actions.name: parse_xml_v2
actions.title: Parse XML document
actions.help: Converts an XML document into structured output for use in later recipe steps. Provide a representative sample to build the output fields, or enable streaming to produce a data stream for larger XML documents.

input.name: streaming
input.label: Enable streaming?
input.hint: Enable when you expect XML documents larger than 10MB. Output is streamed to support documents up to 200MB, optimized for throughput rather than latency. Learn more .

input.name: sample_document
input.label: Sample XML document
input.hint: A representative XML sample used to build this action's output fields.

input.name: document
input.label: XML document
input.hint: The actual XML parsed at runtime.

actions.name: transform_xml_xslt
actions.title: Transform XML using XSLT (Deprecated)
actions.help: This action performs an XSLT (eXtensible Stylesheet Language Transformation) on an XML document. NOTE: This action is deprecated . Please use the new action.

input.name: xml
input.label: Document
input.hint: Enter the XML document on which XSLT should be performed.

input.name: encoding
input.label: Encoding of the file content
input.hint: Specify the encoding of the file to set it explicitly. By default, encoding will be set to UTF-8 if left blank. Click here to know more about the different encodings supported.

input.name: xslt
input.label: XSLT
input.hint: Enter the XSLT to be applied on the XML document. Ensure that any imports/includes does not contain any paths, for example: "imported.xsl".

input.name: xslt_refs
input.label: XSLT references

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.hint: Enter the XSLT name as defined in the href attribute of the XSLT import/include tag. Ensure that it does not contain any paths, for example: "imported.xsl".

properties.name: value
properties.label: Value
properties.hint: Enter the XSLT to be imported/included. Ensure that any imports/includes does not contain any paths, for example: "imported.xsl".

input.hint: If the XSLT above contains imports/includes references, provide the stylesheet names and values below. You may add up to 5 references.

input.name: xslt_params
input.label: XSLT parameters
input.hint: If any of the XSLTs above contains parameters, provide the values below.

input.name: output_type
input.label: Response content type
input.hint: Select expected format of data response type, e.g. JSON or XML. If the response is not in the expected format, the action will fail.

input.name: sample_output
input.label: Response body example
input.hint: Provide a sample document to generate output schema with. When left blank, Workato will only generate a datapill containing the raw transformation output.

actions.name: validate_xml
actions.title: Validate XML document with XSD
actions.help: Validates an XML document against a provided XSD to ensure it's well-formed and schema-compliant. Returns the XML as a string if valid, otherwise raises an error. It is recommended to use datapills for large XML/XSD inputs. The combined size of the XML and XSD files must not exceed 10MB.

input.name: streaming
input.label: Enable streaming?
input.hint: Enable if you expect XML documents larger than 10MB. The validated XML is delivered as a file rather than inline; consume it in a downstream step if needed. Learn more .

input.name: xml_document
input.label: XML Document
input.hint: Enter the XML document to be validated.

input.name: payload_asset_type
input.label: XSD Document
input.hint: • Define manually — Add any referenced XSDs under XSD references below. • Use a resource — References are resolved based on the file's folder path and Workato folder structure.

input.name: xsd_document
input.label: XSD Contents
input.hint: The XSD schema content.

input.label: XSD references

properties.name: name

properties.hint: Enter the XSD name as defined in the schemaLocation attribute of the XSD import/include tag. Use a simple file name without paths, for example: "imported.xsd".

properties.name: value
properties.label: Value
properties.hint: Enter the XSD document to be imported/included.

input.hint: Provide the filename and content for any XSDs imported or included by the schema above.
